name: Feature request / adaptation idea
about: Suggest an improvement, a new install target, or an integration with another pipeline shape
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What you want

A clear description of the feature or adaptation.

## Why it matters

The use case. *"My pipeline doesn't have an `email_messages` table, can the cron run without DB?"* or *"I'd love a Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments"* or *"The CLI doesn't handle stdin input"*.

## What you've considered

- Existing workarounds you've tried.
- Whether this could be done as a separate downstream project instead of in this repo.

## How you could help

- *"I could submit a PR if you point me at the right files"*.
- *"I can test on my pipeline once it's implemented"*.
- *"I can only describe the need, the implementation is on you"*.

All three are fine.
